purpose: Linda V2 owner-private prospect research only
notes: Public websites reviewed 2026-10-08. Questions are hypotheses, not confirmed deficiencies. No outbound contact, booking, sale, payment or CRM mutation.

prospects.name: Houston Mobile Details
prospects.contactMethod: Website footer lists business phone and email
prospects.discoveryQuestion: When a same-day booking request arrives after hours, how do you confirm the service, travel location, and arrival window before the customer books elsewhere?
prospects.publicEvidence: Site advertises same-day appointments and individual service-specific online booking with listed durations/prices.

prospects.name: Dynamo Detailing LLC
prospects.bookingTool: On-site booking-request form; company says it confirms within one hour (not an independently verified live slot reservation)
prospects.discoveryQuestion: How are incoming booking requests triaged during active detailing jobs, and would an automatic acknowledgement plus calendar handoff help you consistently meet your one-hour confirmation promise?
prospects.publicEvidence: Booking form collects customer, vehicle, package, preferred date and service address; site says it will confirm within an hour.

prospects.name: Rolling Water Detailing
prospects.contactMethod: Phone/text and shop address in contact footer
prospects.bookingTool: External Square booking link; site includes placeholder text 'Square Widget Goes Here'
prospects.discoveryQuestion: Are customers dropping off when they encounter the booking-widget placeholder before being sent to Square, and would a direct embedded scheduling flow reduce those steps?
prospects.publicEvidence: Official site shows 'Online Booking — Square Widget Goes Here' and a separate Book on Square link.

prospects.name: Mobility Cleaning
prospects.contactMethod: Official contact form, phone and business email
prospects.bookingTool: Native online booking form requesting preferred date/time; phone/text alternative
prospects.discoveryQuestion: When a customer submits a preferred date and time, does it immediately reserve a slot or require manual confirmation, and how do you prevent conflicting requests during mobile jobs?
prospects.publicEvidence: Booking page has preferred date/time fields, says email confirmation and no upfront payment; contact page also encourages phone/text.

prospects.name: Angel Details
prospects.contactMethod: On-page free quote form, business email and phone
prospects.bookingTool: Quote-request form rather than verified real-time slot selection
prospects.discoveryQuestion: After a quote form is submitted, how quickly does a customer receive an estimate and available time slots, and could automated quote qualification shorten that gap?
prospects.publicEvidence: Site collects vehicle, ZIP, service, condition and contact details and says business will contact customer to confirm pricing and availability.
